items.name: Wielonożny
items.context: Ability: Wielonożny. A multi-legged machine moves across difficult ground. Inventory, item sheet, hotbar and chat icon, typically 16-64 px.
items.request: REVISION cell 2. Keep the broad industrial walker body LEVEL while its articulated legs GRACEFULLY FOLLOW ONE CONTINUOUS HILLY GROUND RIDGE at the bottom. The visible feet REST DIRECTLY ON THE TERRAIN at DIFFERENT HEIGHTS: front foot on a higher crest, middle foot in a lower valley, rear foot on a lower ledge. Each supporting foot's sole touches its own actual ground surface with NO BLACK AIR GAP underneath. One front leg can be lifted mid-step over the next crest; the other feet visibly support the machine. Broad coherent connected legs, simple large joints, complete feet. Terrain is one smooth angular hill ridge, not disconnected rocks below a hovering robot. No gun, fine rubble, bolts, smoke, writing or extra machine.
